# Action Audio

> Car detailing and window tinting in Hartford, Connecticut; car audio, remote starters, electronics replacement, and installation in Wethersfield, near Hartford. Established in 1983.

## Locations and contact
- [Hartford detailing & tinting](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/hartford.html): 2814 Main St, Hartford, CT 06120. Auto detailing and window tinting.
- [Wethersfield electronics](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/wethersfield.html): 105 Silas Deane Hwy, Wethersfield, CT 06109. Car audio, remote starters, vehicle electronics replacement and installation. Public phone: (860) 667-6330. This number belongs to Wethersfield.
- Both stores: Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm Eastern; Sunday closed. Confirm holiday hours.

## Important context
Hartford handles detailing and window tinting; Wethersfield handles electronics. Confirm the work, compatibility, price, and availability with the appropriate store. Most service images are original illustrations; the showroom images show the actual Wethersfield store. Do not treat illustrations as completed customer projects. Electronics repair is not offered; the electronics service is replacement and installation. Pricing, completion time, equipment availability, and compatibility require confirmation. Vehicle tracking requires a private code and is not public directory content.

## Detailed service reference

### Car audio & stereo installation — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/car-audio.html

A great system starts with the right combination of equipment. Tell us what you listen to, what you like about your current setup, and what you want to improve. We’ll discuss speaker fit, available space, power needs, and how to retain the factory features you use.

#### Choose a speaker, amplifier, or subwoofer upgrade
Start with what you want to hear differently. Speaker upgrades can change the clarity and character of your music; a subwoofer adds low-frequency output, while an amplifier must be matched to the speakers, power needs, and available space. Tell our Wethersfield team how you listen and what equipment is already in the vehicle.

#### Car stereo installation and factory integration
Replacing a radio involves more than choosing a screen size. Dash fit, wiring harnesses, factory amplification, steering-wheel controls, and existing cameras can affect the installation. Share your vehicle year, make, model, and trim so we can discuss a compatible receiver and any required interfaces before you buy equipment.

#### Plan your car audio installation estimate
A focused speaker upgrade and a full audio system have different equipment and labor requirements. Include your goals, optional budget, and model numbers for equipment you already own. Visit 105 Silas Deane Hwy in Wethersfield, near Hartford, after the team confirms your appointment and installation scope.

- Speaker upgrades and component systems
- Subwoofers, enclosures, and amplifiers
- Touchscreen receivers and factory-system integration

Before visiting: Bring your vehicle’s year, make, and model, plus the model numbers of any equipment you already own.

#### Can I keep my factory radio?
In many vehicles, an audio upgrade can work with the existing radio. The approach depends on your factory system, so we’ll review compatibility before recommending equipment.

#### Do I need a whole new system?
Not necessarily. Share what you’d like to improve and we can discuss a focused upgrade or a complete system.

### Remote starters — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/remote-starters.html

The right remote starter depends on your vehicle’s ignition, security system, and the range you need. Our team can discuss compatible options and any additional integration hardware before an installation is scheduled.

#### Choose remote range and control options
Think about where you usually park and how you would like to start the vehicle. Remote range, one-way or two-way feedback, and smartphone control depend on the system you choose. Ask the team to explain compatible options and any connected-service fees before making a decision.

#### What affects remote starter installation cost?
Your ignition type, transmission, factory security system, selected starter, and any necessary interface hardware affect the installation. Share your year, make, model, trim, and number of working keys. The Wethersfield team will review compatibility and provide an estimate before scheduling the work.

- Vehicle and factory-key compatibility review
- Remote range and control options
- Installation planning and system walkthrough

Before visiting: Have your year, make, model, transmission type, and number of working keys ready. Ask the team which keys to bring to your appointment.

#### Will it work with my vehicle?
Compatibility varies by vehicle, transmission, ignition, and factory security system. Contact us with your vehicle details before choosing a starter.

#### Can I start my car from my phone?
Some systems offer smartphone control through additional hardware and a connected service. Ask about compatible options and any recurring fees.

### Car alarms & security — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/car-alarms.html

A security system should fit the way you use your vehicle. We’ll discuss the features you need and how an aftermarket system may work with your existing locks, keys, and factory electronics.



- Alarm and keyless-entry options
- Factory security compatibility
- Sensor and remote-control options

Before visiting: Tell us about your existing alarm or remote starter and any issues you are experiencing.

#### Can security and remote start work together?
Some systems combine both. Compatibility and integration needs must be checked for your particular vehicle.

### Motorcycle audio — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/motorcycle-audio.html

Motorcycle installations have different space, mounting, and environmental requirements from car systems. Ask the team to confirm service availability and suitable equipment for your specific bike.



- Motorcycle-specific fit and equipment review
- Speaker and amplifier options
- Weather exposure and power considerations

Before visiting: Share your motorcycle’s year, make, model, and existing audio equipment.

#### Can any car speaker go on a motorcycle?
No. Fit, mounting, weather exposure, and electrical requirements need to be considered. Confirm a suitable setup before purchasing equipment.

### Video & entertainment — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/video-systems.html

Screen placement and vehicle compatibility matter. Tell us who will use the system, the devices you want to connect, and the type of entertainment you have in mind. Our team can confirm available options and installation requirements.



- Seatback and drop-down video inquiries
- Touchscreen receiver options
- Source, power, and mounting compatibility

Before visiting: Bring vehicle details and information about the phones, streaming devices, or media sources you plan to use.

#### Can I add Apple CarPlay or Android Auto?
Compatible aftermarket receivers may support these features. Vehicle fit, phone compatibility, and wired or wireless support depend on the receiver.

### Power liftgates — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/power-liftgates.html

Power liftgate systems are vehicle-specific. The first step is checking whether a suitable kit exists for your exact vehicle and what modifications it requires. Our team will confirm available service options before you book installation.



- Vehicle-specific kit availability
- Control and opening-height options
- Installation and compatibility consultation

Before visiting: Share your year, make, model, and trim, and whether your liftgate is currently manual or powered.

#### Is every SUV compatible?
No. Kit availability and installation requirements vary by vehicle and trim. Contact us for a compatibility review.

### Connected accessories — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/vehicle-accessories.html

An accessory should feel like it belongs in your vehicle. Tell us what you want to add and we’ll review equipment compatibility, available installation options, and any required subscriptions or adapters.



- Satellite radio and SiriusXM integration inquiries
- HomeLink and convenience accessory inquiries
- Factory system and receiver compatibility

Before visiting: Share vehicle details and the model of your factory or aftermarket receiver.

#### Does a new accessory require a new radio?
It depends on the accessory and your current system. Some use adapters; others need a compatible receiver. We’ll help you understand the options.

Replacement planning covers equipment selection, compatible installation parts, and the agreed work at our Wethersfield store.

- Replacement receivers, speakers, and electronics
- Vehicle fit and factory-feature compatibility
- Equipment selection and installation planning

Before visiting: Share your vehicle year, make, model, trim, and the brand or model of the equipment you want to replace.

#### Do you repair electronics?
No. We offer replacement and installation of vehicle electronics at our Wethersfield store.

#### Where do I go for a replacement?
Visit 105 Silas Deane Hwy, Wethersfield, CT 06109. Start with an estimate request so we can review your vehicle and equipment.

### Auto detailing — Hartford
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/auto-detailing.html

Every vehicle arrives with a different story. Tell us which areas need attention, from daily wear to a refresh before a special occasion. The team will confirm the available detailing services and scope with you.

#### Interior car detailing in Hartford
Start with the areas you use every day: seats, carpets, floor mats, dashboard, door panels, and cargo space. Tell our Hartford team about spills, stains, odors, pet hair, or sensitive upholstery. These details help us discuss the appropriate interior care and confirm what can be addressed before work begins.

#### Exterior detailing for your vehicle
For exterior care, describe the condition of the paint, wheels, glass, and trim, along with any areas that need special attention. Request exterior detailing on its own or discuss interior and exterior care together. The team will confirm the work suited to your vehicle; specific treatments and results depend on its condition.

#### What affects a car detailing estimate?
Vehicle size, condition, and the agreed interior or exterior work affect the price and appointment length. Include your year, make, model, priorities, and any existing damage in the estimate request. We will contact you to discuss the scope and approximate pricing. Remove personal belongings before your confirmed visit to 2814 Main St, Hartford.

- A conversation about your vehicle’s condition
- Detailing scope tailored to your needs
- Scheduling and care recommendations

Before visiting: Mention stains, sensitive surfaces, or specific areas of concern. Ask the team how to prepare your vehicle before drop-off.

#### How long will detailing take?
Timing depends on the vehicle’s condition and the agreed scope. The team will discuss a schedule when confirming your appointment.

#### Where is your Hartford car detailing shop?
Detailing is offered at 2814 Main St, Hartford, CT 06120. The Hartford store is open Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm, and closed Sundays. Confirm your appointment and holiday hours with the team.

#### Can I request interior and exterior detailing?
Yes. Tell us whether you need interior care, exterior care, or both. Describe stains, odors, sensitive materials, and surface concerns so the team can confirm the available work and scope.

#### How much does car detailing cost?
Pricing depends on vehicle size, condition, and the agreed work. Request an estimate with your vehicle make and model. The team will discuss the details and approximate price before you arrange service.

#### How should I prepare for a detailing appointment?
Remove personal belongings and tell the team about any sensitive surfaces or existing damage. Confirm specific drop-off instructions and timing when your appointment is arranged.

### Electrical installation — Wethersfield
Source: https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/electrical-installation.html

From an aftermarket receiver to a more involved electronics upgrade, the details start with your vehicle and the equipment you choose. Contact the team to discuss the project before purchasing parts.

#### Vehicle electronics installation in Wethersfield
Plan an installation around the feature you need: a replacement stereo, speakers and an amplifier, a remote starter, a dash camera, or a GPS tracker. Each device has different mounting, wiring, and power requirements. Our Wethersfield team reviews your vehicle and equipment before confirming a suitable installation.

#### Check compatibility before buying equipment
Vehicle year, make, model, trim, factory electronics, and accessory model numbers help identify installation requirements. Tell us about steering-wheel controls, a factory camera, or other features you want to keep. Confirm any mounting kits, harnesses, and integration interfaces with the team before purchasing parts.

- Equipment and vehicle compatibility
- Installation planning and cable routing
- A walkthrough of your new setup

Before visiting: Have your vehicle details and equipment model numbers ready, including any adapters or accessories you already have.

#### Can I bring my own equipment?
Ask the team first. We’ll review the model, condition, and required installation parts before confirming the work.

#### Where can I book car electronics installation near Hartford?
Book with the Wethersfield store at 105 Silas Deane Hwy, Wethersfield, CT 06109. Electronics installation is available through this location; the Hartford store offers detailing and window tinting.

#### Do I need adapters for an aftermarket receiver?
Your vehicle and chosen receiver determine the required harnesses, mounting parts, and integration adapters. Share the year, make, model, trim, and equipment model before purchasing installation parts.

#### Can I keep my factory vehicle controls?
Compatibility depends on the vehicle, factory system, new equipment, and available interfaces. Ask the team to review any steering-wheel controls, camera, or factory features you want to retain.

### Which Action Audio location should I visit?
Visit 2814 Main St in Hartford for interior and exterior car detailing and window tinting. Visit 105 Silas Deane Hwy in Wethersfield for car audio, remote starters, dash cams, GPS trackers, and vehicle electronics replacement and installation.

### How do I get a detailing or electronics installation estimate?
Use the estimate form to choose your service and enter your vehicle year, make, model, and project details. The request goes to the appropriate store, and the team will call you to discuss the scope and approximate pricing.

### Is an online appointment request confirmed immediately?
No. Submitting the form requests a visit. Your appointment is confirmed after the Action Audio team contacts you about the service, date, and availability.
